methods: B21 ASK WHO ELSE HAS THIS SHAPE

proved_change: For Boolean uniform product null, bounded degree-D LDA plus fixed coordinate-resampling noise rules out strong distinction by polynomial-size read-once DNFs whenever D/log(m+2) tends to infinity and the null acceptance probability tends to zero.
The proof splits narrow terms, controlled directly by bounded LDA, from wide terms, controlled by an exact absolute-Fourier coefficient generating function and a Chernoff tail extraction.
The theorem extends exactly to read-once cylinder DNFs over every fixed finite uniform alphabet using tensor characters, with local radius r_{q,z}=(1+(q-1)rho z)/q.
Mao's successful rank test therefore cannot have a read-once DNF representation of subexp(D_n) term count; quantitatively liminf log m_n / D_n >= log(2/(1+rho)) in the Boolean case.
scope: Concrete test-side sufficient theorem for fixed finite uniform product nulls and read-once cylinder DNFs after fixed independent resampling; not a full-source characterization and not a proof of the unrestricted low-degree conjecture.
mao_boundary: Respected quantitatively: Mao has exact low-degree matching but his noised rank-test acceptance set cannot have the read-once cylinder-DNF structure at subexponential-in-D_n size.
prior_art: Haramaty-Lee-Viola bounded-independence-plus-noise product-test results and Hsieh et al. rigorous low-degree implications are relevant prior art. The conjunction/cylinder-specific bounded-LDA robustification here has UNVERIFIED novelty.
remaining_gap: Extend beyond disjoint conjunction/cylinder blocks: limited-overlap DNFs, arbitrary bounded product tests under merely bounded LDA, or signed S_n graph-shape norms that preserve orbit cancellation. Arbitrary polynomial-time algorithms remain far outside the theorem.
next_attack: Develop a limited-overlap cluster expansion for the noise-weighted Fourier tail using the term-intersection graph.
Extract a variance-controlled low-degree majorant from bounded-independence-plus-noise product-test proofs to upgrade exact moment matching to bounded LDA.
Develop a signed invariant graph-shape norm and test it against Mao's mandatory rank-test obstruction.
